prompt: Some university students want to learn about other subjects in addition to their main subjects Others believe it is more important to give all their time and attention to studying for a qualification. essay:

This essay will discuss both perspectives before introducing my own opinion.

The proponent of this claim, emphasises that learning some additional courses can lead to significant changes in the youngstar personality. For example, studying some modules related to management, critical thinking and  personal growth. Could make an enormous development in the student's mentality . Specifically, in the aspect of dealing with problems and managing individuals. Also, learning some skills such as, collecting data, analsying and making a descions that university subjects could not provide. After analysing these facts. It is clear  why many people support this matter and are consistently looking for knowledge acquisitions related to this kind develops.

On the other hand, some people argue that  scholars should prioritise university courses and attempt to master them before looking for any kind of further education. Therefore, the learner could not achieve that without the concept of intensity and repetition. For instance, when scholars try to learn a new language, memorising some new words in a short period could lead to a kind of shallow learning. So, learners may forget those words after a while. For this reason, pupils prefer not distrepute thier effort on larg scale of subjects.

In conclusion, as we mentioned before, both views displayed a reseanable evidences to their claim, including looking to develop personality and gain mastery.
